transfer_to_h2_contract.rule: Freeze behavior + Golden Traces + interventions, then implement equivalent semantics in ClayCode.
transfer_to_h2_contract.language_gap_rule: If ClayCode cannot express validated H1 semantics, reopen BASE; do not simplify H1 to fit the language.

completion_falsifier: Any current fixed target contract omitted, any semantic slice lacking executable trace/intervention mapping, or any hidden host-language state/effect path that cannot be represented in H2.
